annotations.title: Top up your wallet by paying over MPP or x402 (no human)

description: Add money to your wallet by paying it yourself, with no human or browser: amount in USD. The first call answers payment required with the ways to pay: MPP (a card through a Stripe shared payment token from your owner's Link agent wallet, or USDC on Tempo) and x402 (USDC on Base). Pay one and call again with the credential in _meta (org.paymentauth/credential for MPP, x402/payment for x402); MPP and x402 client libraries do this for you. Card top-ups can be charged back; stablecoin top-ups cannot. Each top-up counts against the account's daily deposit limit.

amount.description: US dollars, at most two decimals. From the minimum deposit ($1.00 by default) to the daily deposit limit ($1,000 by default).
